2021
Launched the
Perpetual Multi 
Asset ESG Real 
Return Fund.
Laminar Capital 
launched
ESG and Carbon 
Risk Score.
Announced our 
20 weeks paid 
parental leave policy 
for either parent
to use flexibly.
Launched LinkedIn Learning
for Perpetual employees.
Launched
Enhanced 
Diversity 
and Inclusion 
Strategy.
Published our first
Modern Slavery 
Statement.
Launched our 
2021–2023 
Stretch RAP.
Support for
>100
not-for-profit clients 
on their investments, 
governance and 
access to funding.
Gave equivalent to nearly
$2.4m
through community 
giving and volunteering.
+49 NPS
in FY22, our highest 
ever score for client 
experience.
Perpetual philanthropy 
clients distributed
$1b
in funds to the 
community sector 
in the last 11 years.
Launched
Trillium ESG 
Global Equity 
Fund and the 
Trillium Global 
Sustainable 
Opportunities 
Fund
in Australia.
Three ESG 
funds launched 
and one 
authorised
in Europe, 
which are classified as 
Article 8 under SFDR 
regulation.
Trillium joined
Net Zero Asset 
Managers 
Initiative.
Launched our first active ETF,
Perpetual Ethical SRI Fund (Managed Fund) (ASX: GIVE).
38%
Achieved
from 29% in 2020
female Board members.
2022
Trillium named 
among the 2022
‘Best for 
the World’
Certified B Corporations 
(B Corps) by B Lab, 
a recognition achieved 
every year running 
since 2013.
2020
Acquired 
Trillium,
pioneers in integrated 
ESG investing.
Acquired 
Barrow Hanley,
who leverage a 
proprietary Composite 
ESG Score.
